scope: Exact current-state inference and two basic policies for examples with 10–15 independent genes and 10–15 individuals per family.

extraction.inference.py: Complete numerical kernel; renamed module imports, CaseDescriptor -> PedigreeCase, ArrayInferenceState -> InferenceState, ScientificSuccessInference -> PedigreeInference.
extraction.nuclear.py: Complete exact nuclear specialization; renamed model/inference imports and factory -> make_inference.
extraction.junction_tree.py: Canonical tree builder; removed unused rooted-separator partition classes and partition_for_test. Removed matching obsolete __all__ exports.
extraction.model.py: Only required model fields from CaseDescriptor; no audit metadata or external production adapter; new JSON loader and synthetic examples.
extraction.policies.py: Only recursive-myopic action loop and horizon-one information choice; nuclear moment shortcut and original tie tolerances retained.
extraction.__main__.py: New bounded single-trajectory installation example with hidden panels revealed only after action choice.
extraction.checks/: Standalone software correctness checks for the extracted package.

excluded: all source tests and generated results
source Git history and remote configuration
private datasets, machine paths and environment files
